minimumLoadShare.source: Demo setting: permit pause down to zero for visible control; matches the year explorer comparison scenario in config/reference-house.json.

allowedCpuCoresPerContainer.source: Demo setting: one Docker CPU per visual node, limited by compose.live-demo.yml; not a 1 kW power measurement.

targetTemperatureMinC.source: Demo mapping choice: lower endpoint of the illustrative slider; not a measured room temperature.

targetTemperatureMaxC.source: Demo mapping choice: upper endpoint corresponding to a full reference-server heat request; not a measured room temperature.
